All 8008 ten-vertex induced subcomplexes have local H3 zero; all 4368 eleven-vertex induced subcomplexes have local H3 exactly 1 for the 150 facet complements and zero otherwise. For both distinct S6 orbits (30,120) a local 3-cycle was independently reduced modulo global im boundary_4 to certify nonzero inclusion image, giving the exact claimed carrier and orbit classifications. Representatives independently give f=(11,55,92,52,4) and (11,55,95,58,7). No inference from a verifier log or sampling.
residual_risks: Exhaustiveness depends on precisely the frozen Datta labeling and triangulation; all 16-vertex supports enumerated, but no corresponding theorem for other triangulations or integral coefficients.
